title: Pizza with meat and fruit, medium crust

content.title: About
content.content: Pizza with meat and fruit is an original combination of juicy meat (usually ham, sausage or chicken) and sweet fruits (pineapple, apple, pear). A medium‑thick crust provides a balance between a crispy edge and a soft interior. The pizza is suitable for family dinners as well as festive gatherings.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: The meat‑and‑fruit pairing is popular in Hawaiian cuisine, where the classic “Hawaiian” pizza features ham and pineapple.
Fruits add natural sweetness and help soften the salty flavor of the meat.
Medium crust is typically baked at 220‑240 °C for 10‑12 minutes, yielding a golden crust while keeping the topping moist.
Pizza with fruit is often served with a light tomato base, sometimes enhanced with barbecue sauce for extra depth.

items.title: Rich source of protein
items.content: The meat provides high‑quality protein essential for tissue growth and repair.

items.title: Vitamins and minerals from fruit
items.content: Fruits contribute vitamin C, potassium and dietary fiber, supporting immunity and digestion.

items.title: Energy provision
items.content: Carbohydrates from the crust, protein from the meat, and simple sugars from the fruit deliver both quick and sustained energy.

items.title: High calorie content
items.content: Meat‑and‑fruit pizza can be calorie‑dense due to cheese, crust and fatty meats; moderation is advised.

items.title: Allergy to ingredients
items.content: Some individuals may be allergic to dairy, gluten in the crust, or specific types of meat.

items.title: Sodium level
items.content: Processed meats and sauces often contain a lot of salt; people with hypertension should choose lower‑sodium options.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: Serve the pizza hot, cut into individual slices. Fresh basil or arugula can be added after baking for aroma. Optionally drizzle with a light yogurt sauce or spicy chili.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Store leftovers in an airtight container in the refrigerator for up to 2‑3 days. Reheat in an oven or grill pan to restore a crispy crust.
